sample.question: Find the total number of students enrolled in the colleges that were founded after the year of 1850 for each affiliation type.
sample.completion:
```sql
SELECT T2.Affiliation, SUM(T3.Enrollment) as Total_Students
FROM university AS T1
JOIN basketball_match AS T2 ON T1.School_ID = T2.School_ID
JOIN university AS T3 ON T1.School_ID = T3.School_ID
WHERE T2.Founded > 1850
GROUP BY T2.Affiliation
```
